note: Sumter County Recreation & Parks campground west of Pinewood, adjacent to Manchester State Forest and a Palmetto Trail access. Fishing pier. A general campground that also offers 20 horse stables. RV Life: unrated. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 126 sites, 50 A (30/50) + water, showers on the county's page; Google Maps shows it open (4.4 over 51 reviews, county page linked). Booking: the page only says to call 803-436-2248, nothing on reservations. Note trimmed of field facts. Not stated: booking, season, rig length, dump.
flags: Rates undated: the county's only page for the park ($20 30-amp / $25 50-amp / $5 tent) is an undated write-up of the 2014 Penny for Progress renovation, so the stored fees have no 2024+ operator date. A call to 803-436-2248 would confirm current rates and whether sites are reservable.
